description: Audit eligibility and format Specially Adapted Housing (SAH) and ADA accessibility assessment exclusion under 38 U.S.C. § 2101 & T.C.A. § 67-5-601 to excise medically necessary mobility improvements from residential property assessment.

accessibility_improvements_cost.description: Documented contractor/material cost of accessibility improvements (ramps, roll-in showers, lifts)

county_tax_rate.description: Combined county and municipal tax rate per $100 assessed (default 3.0137)

current_assessed_improvement_value.description: Current building assessed value on county CAMA card

has_sah_or_sha_grant.description: Whether veteran received VA Specially Adapted Housing or Special Home Adaptation grant (VA Form 26-4555)

va_disability_percentage.description: VA service-connected disability percentage (min 10% or physician certified)

name: audit_veteran_sah_ada_exclusion
